checks.finding: REQ-001 through REQ-011 specify inspectable schemas, canonical bytes, signatures, validation outcomes, protection inventories, consumer behavior and verification surfaces. The RT-20260909-002 amendment defines exact decoded response text, required members, nonce constraints, adapter selection and isolated failure categories (requirements.md:24-72), supporting concrete implementation and verification decisions.

AC-001 through AC-046 and their Requirement/Test-ID mappings cover all eleven requirements. The amendment explicitly maps its response and cleanup changes to REQ-010, AC-027/AC-032 and independently named TEST-027-RT002/TEST-032-RT002 cases (acceptance-tests.md:3-128).

Acceptance targets specify observable validation results, byte/hash equality, staged versus live state, denial outcomes and recovery states. Amendment fixtures require exact exit/category assertions and absence of success markers; the valid response and emitted patch have exact positive assertions (acceptance-tests.md:12-22).

Non-goals explicitly separate A1 schemas and verification logic from downstream capability machinery, repository instance data and live cross-runtime enforcement. The amendment limits recovery admission to RT-20260909-002 repair and scoped provenance reviews, excluding ordinary bootstrap, unrelated work, quality-gate completion and integration (requirements.md:90-106).

The post-implementation amendment lacks the required approval/provenance declaration. requirements.md:11-21 references historical Passed/Done records, requirements.md:90-98 asserts a human-authorized recovery admission, and acceptance-tests.md:5-8 and :135-139 reference existing RED fixtures and historical A1 Done while Spec-Review-Status is Pending. However, the completely read investigation.md has no '## Amendment Re-Review Context' section, full amendment commit hashes, amended-document fingerprints, dated verbatim human approval quotation, or referenced later-phase artifact pins. Under spec-review-calibration.md's Amendment Re-Review Context rules, phase-sequencing suppression therefore does not apply. A downstream task author or verifier cannot establish the authorized post-implementation amendment boundary from this package. This is a specification-stage approval-boundary defect, not a request for implementation evidence or completed tests; Critical follows the calibration's unsafe/unauthorized workflow-boundary classification. Add a conforming, hash-pinned declaration with all four required evidence elements before resubmission.

Approval forgery, weakening, protected writes and publication failures have planned validation surfaces in AC-014, AC-019/020, AC-023, AC-030, AC-033, AC-036 and AC-043. The amendment separately specifies synthetic negative fixtures and a fresh installed-verifier/native-dispatch activation observation, explicitly declining to treat fixtures as host attestation or A8 completion (requirements.md:76-106; acceptance-tests.md:135-139).
The permitted project-root existence check found no domain/ directory; the check's explicit skip condition applies.
